run_outcome_note: The flagship measurement was NOT obtained. CORRECTED CAUSE (2026-08-05): not throttling. AzureBenchClient runs max_retries=5 against DATAFORGE_AZURE_TIMEOUT_S=180 with min(2*(attempt+1),120) backoff, so a single hung request consumes 5*180 + 20 = 920s (~15.3 min) before raising TimeoutError, which the flagship loop catches per-issue and continues past. That matches the observed ~15-minute silent window exactly. Consequently real billable calls in that window were ~5, not ~540, and the original ~.90 receipt overstated spend by up to ~100x; it has been reissued with the corrected cause and bound. This artifact contains only a 3-issue smoke sample and no flagship samples. The primary endpoint is discharged as a NULL on the basis of the ARM SWEEP (eval/results/corrector_arm_sweep.json, 173 issues), not this file.
